DNJ must have god’s hand behind it. I had posted a rather fiery comment to this blog post, and I got the infamous SqlParameter error.

Maybe god doesn’t want me to stuff up a chilli up such a recruiter’s butt afterall?

That is quite a list of skills required! Reading through I thought it wasn’t too bad, until the pay!!! Holy cow, what a shocker! You’ve _got_ to be kidding.

Most MS GUI component devs from pre-.NET days have done OCX work (ex: in VB6), which is a class ActiveX DLL, but as you pointed out, both don’t have a good place (except for legacy support) in managed code. The misjive between .ActiveX, Palm, OCX, and .NET is disconcerting, but understandable if having to support legacy environments (sorry Palm).

You’ve nailed it on the head: "This reeks of poor management and an environment of frustration."

Omg that looks like a posing for my job. I do pretty much all that for about 29/hr (pre tax). i wish i could leave…

"This reeks of poor management and an environment of frustration."
Yup.
